proposal.hypothesis: Giving the model the full symbol signatures and one worked example of the reply shape raises the pass rate, because most failures are wrong shape, not wrong logic.
proposal.reasoning: The baseline prompt names the symbols but never shows their signatures or the reply shape. A model that guesses the shape fails a correct algorithm. Showing both removes that whole failure class.
